mapper.select: SELECT h.hobby_id::TEXT AS row_id, h.name AS hobby_name, h.summary, dc.name AS difficulty_name FROM hobby h LEFT JOIN code dc ON dc.code_id = h.difficulty_cd AND dc.p_code_id = 'HOBBYLV00' WHERE h.use_yn = 'Y' AND (h.name ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR h.summary ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\') ORDER BY h.sort_no, h.hobby_id LIMIT #{previewSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hobby h WHERE h.use_yn = 'Y' AND (h.name ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR h.summary ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\')

SELECT r.recruit_id::TEXT AS row_id, r.title, r.region, r.meet_dt, r.status_cd, ho.name AS hobby_name, sc.name AS status_name FROM recruit r LEFT JOIN hobby ho ON ho.hobby_id = r.hobby_id LEFT JOIN code sc ON sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00' WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND (r.title ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR r.content ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\') ORDER BY r.recruit_id DESC LIMIT #{previewSize}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recruit r WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND (r.title ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR r.content ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\')
mapper.sql: FROM post p WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' AND p.p_post_id = 0 AND p.secret_yn = 'N' AND (p.title ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR regexp_replace(COALESCE(p.content, ''), '<[^>]*>', ' ', 'g') ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\')
mapper.select:
SELECT p.post_id::TEXT AS row_id, p.board_id, p.title, (SELECT u.nickname FROM member u WHERE u.member_id = p.reg_id) AS reg_name, (SELECT b.name FROM board b WHERE b.board_id = p.board_id) AS board_name, TO_CHAR(p.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt, -- 본문에서 찾았을 때만 스니펫: 매칭 지점 앞 20자부터 120자를 잘라 문맥을 보여준다 CASE WHEN p.title NOT ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\' THEN BTRIM(SUBSTRING(regexp_replace(COALESCE(p.content, ''), '<[^>]*>', ' ', 'g') FROM GREATEST(1, POSITION(LOWER(#{keyword}) IN LOWER(regexp_replace(COALESCE(p.content, ''), '<[^>]*>', ' ', 'g'))) - 20) FOR 120)) END AS search_snippet
-- 제목에서 찾은 글을 본문에서만 찾은 글보다 앞에(간단한 관련도 정렬) ORDER BY (p.title ILIKE '%' || #{keywordLike} || '%' ESCAPE '\') DESC, p.post_id DESC LIMIT #{previewSize}
